name: GMod Toolkit
author: Catualus
description: Garry's Mod server tools: an overview with client download size and live error counts, a workshop collection viewer with size and freshness charts, an addon browser with bulk enable/disable and disk usage, a Lua error digest with a position timeline, and a curated addon library that installs AdvDupe2, Wiremod, Stacker, ULX and more straight onto the server.
